message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②, e): StandbyRunner -- the app's leases, one per PC, each with its own pump thread

What the APK bridge (and a PC client) will hold; portable, so the desktop e2e runs the same object. Start(key) opens
and admits a lease for that PC (its capability from the factory) and pumps it on its thread; StatusOf(key) is a
snapshot the pump publishes (the UI polls it without the lease lock); TakeActivation(key, args) gives the activation
connect's arguments and the pump leaves the socket alone until SessionOver(key); Release(key) ends the thread and
releases a parked entry at the host. GenerationAllocator now locks (several leases, one counter per install).
Shipping: nothing in the apps calls it yet (automatic preconnect stays OFF).
